svg.title: Transactional outbox: technology and process boundaries
svg.desc: Django saves Job and OutboxEvent together in PostgreSQL. A separate Python relay uses the Celery client to publish to RabbitMQ. Publisher confirmation returns to the relay. A separate Celery worker calls our Python task, fetches the original, then uses valid cache or parses the résumé. Official logos identify four technologies; a generic queue symbol represents the broker.

g.text: relay_once: lock one due, unsent row
Consumes task and calls our code

svg.text: Logos identify technology. Node colors identify roles.
RabbitMQ uses a generic queue symbol.
